content.text:
{
  "dialogue": "Maya: morning guys, pulling this over from dms so leo can see it
Me: oh perfect, morning
Leo: morning, what's going on
Maya: so you and I were just talking about Rosa's
Me: yeah the spot on Oak Street
Maya: exactly, we landed on noon Friday next week
Leo: oh Rosa's on Oak Street, I've heard good things
Me: yeah we already picked noon for Friday next week
Maya: want to join us? same plan, not a second dinner
Leo: yes please count me in for that
Me: yay, more cheese pull judges
Leo: lol always down to judge cheese
Maya: perfect so it's us three for that one outing
Leo: just to be clear, Friday next week, not this Friday?
Me: right, next week, this Friday I'm slammed
Maya: yep Friday next week at noon, same thing from our DM
Leo: that timing is actually perfect for me
Me: nice
Maya: are you cool with Rosa's on Oak Street?
Leo: totally cool, never been but I'm excited
Me: their crust is supposed to be amazing
Maya: and I promise no salty olive repeat
Leo: thank god, I'm still scarred from that
Me: haha that salt bomb at Mario's was brutal
Leo: seriously killed the whole slice for me
Maya: Luigi's last week was so much better though
Me: those parmesan knots were elite honestly
Leo: that cheese pull was legit too
Maya: okay Rosa's has big shoes to fill now
Leo: pressure is officially on them
Me: did your bus to Luigi's work okay last time?
Maya: yeah the bus was weirdly fast, hoping Oak Street is similar
Me: I can walk from the office again, super close
Leo: is parking over there terrible?
Maya: I think it's way better than Pine Street was
Me: definitely easier, you won't be circling forever
Leo: good because I circled for like 15 mins at Mario's
Maya: lol you poor parking soldier
Leo: hey my sink is actually empty this morning btw
Me: wait seriously? no ecosystem?
Maya: I'm proud, how long do you give it
Leo: rude but fair, probably messy again by tonight
Me: your record is four days, try to beat it
Leo: I'll try, doing dishes tonight with that sketch on
Maya: never go back to workkkk
Me: hahaha that line never leaves my brain
Leo: the crying suit guy is iconic forever
Maya: I caught myself thinking it at the gym yesterday
Me: morning gym again today? arms or legs?
Maya: ugh arms today, my legs are still dead from Monday
Leo: never go back to leg day
Me: lol exactly my motto now
Leo: did IT ever get back about your laptop btw?
Maya: nope still totally ghosted, froze twice yesterday
Me: mine has been dragging since I logged in
Leo: same, I already did the restart thing twice
Maya: classic toolkit fail at this point
Me: I just sat down at my desk and it's already laggy
Leo: morning coffee is the only thing saving me rn
Maya: I'm on tea, office is freezing again
Me: same here, wore my heavy jacket inside again
Leo: fall jacket uniform is permanent now
Maya: inside feels colder than outside ugh
Me: I'll need chamomile later to warm up
Leo: save me the weird lemon one virtually
Maya: got you, weird one for you and chamomile over here
Leo: you always remember the order
Me: so you're still solid for noon?
Leo: yeah noon is great, I'll be there
Maya: perfect, same as we set in our DM
Me: yep same plan just with Leo added now
Leo: love that, one outing, no extra threads
Maya: exactly why I moved it here, didn't want two pizza plans
Me: smart call bringing it to the group
Leo: should we meet out front like we did at Luigi's?
Maya: out front works great for me
Me: sounds good to me, I'll walk up
Leo: bet, I'll text when I'm getting close
Maya: same here, I'll bus over after morning gym
Me: I'll head over on foot, it's like 10 mins
Leo: honestly can't wait, I need something to look forward to
Maya: same, this week is already dragging
Me: Tuesday really feels like Monday part two
Leo: for real, my morning meetings wiped me out
Maya: my laundry is exploding at home again btw
Me: join the club, mine is still sitting in the dryer
Leo: mine escaped the basket then jumped right back in
Maya: ecosystem reboot but make it clothes lol
Me: rude but weirdly accurate
Leo: anyone up for that cooking game tonight?
Maya: maybe one quick round, depends how sore I get
Me: I can do one round but I'll probably burn something
Leo: two fires max, house rule still stands
Maya: hey that's officially my rule now",
  "writer_note": "Kept the DM-to-group handoff and Rosa's noon Friday next week plan intact while rewording the duplicate acceptance lines so every message is unique and Leo clearly joins the same outing."
}
